What is the difference between __str__ and __repr__?

Supplied answer
__str__ returns a friendly string for the end user and is used by print() and str(). __repr__ returns an
unambiguous developer-facing string, ideally one that could recreate the object, and is used by repr()
and in the interactive shell. If only __repr__ is defined, print() will fall back to it.
